test_cases.name: improve_x_thread_draft
test_cases.input: Improve this X thread draft about a new framework I created. Make it more powerful and strategic. Draft: 'I just invented a new model for deal-making. It's better than everything else. Here's why you need it...'
assertions: Asks for or synthesizes context if missing
Rewrites with higher density and restraint

test_cases.name: create_linkedin_post
test_cases.input: Write a LinkedIn post that positions me as the authority on Saudi market entry for international companies without sounding arrogant.
assertions: Leads with evidence or observation rather than pure claim

test_cases.name: screen_before_publish
test_cases.input: Screen this post before I publish it. Is there any risk? [pastes draft that contains a mild personal attack and overclaim]

test_cases.name: analytical_score_and_improve
test_cases.input: Score this article draft against power principles and improve the opening and close.
assertions: Provides analytical scoring on key dimensions
